title: Amazingly Crisp Ethiopian Padron Peppers Gomen
description: A jammy, crisp, and flavorful Ethiopian dish featuring padron peppers, perfect for a brunch mood, this satvik-friendly gomen is a must try.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the padron peppers with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the peppers on a baking sheet and broil for 10 minutes, or until the skin is blistered and charred.
While the peppers are broiling, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is softened and translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the berbere spice to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Once the peppers are done broiling, remove them from the oven and let them cool down for a few minutes.
Peel off the skin from the peppers and chop them into small pieces, then add them to the skillet with the onion mixture.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Season the gomen with salt and black pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
